description: Sensor that watches an approval-token directory for `approved: false` tokens with a `feedback: "..."` field, and re-triggers an upstream job with that feedback captured as new input — letting the agent revise based on the human's specific rejection reason. Bounded by `max_iterations` so a stubborn agent can't loop forever. Composes with HumanApprovalGate / SlackApprovalGate / TeamsApprovalGate via shared `approval_dir`. Writes feedback to `{approval_dir}/.feedback/{partition_key}.txt` — pipeline reads it via a `synthesize` step (typed input `feedback: {from: <file-reader-step>}`) OR a plain `source: {kind: file, path: ...}`. Moves consumed rejection tokens to `.consumed/` so they aren't re-processed. Persists iteration state in `.state/{partition_key}.json`. Optional companion state DataFrame asset for observability into which partitions are mid-loop.

outputs.description: ONE sensor. Optionally ONE state DataFrame asset when `emit_state_asset: true`.

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Shared directory approval-gate components write tokens into. Accepts local paths (`/tmp/approvals`) OR cloud URIs (`s3://bucket/prefix`, `gs://bucket/prefix`, `abfs://...`). Cloud URIs require the matching fsspec driver (`s3fs` / `gcsfs` / `adlfs`).

target_job_name.label: Target Job Name
target_job_name.description: Job to re-materialize when a rejection-with-feedback token is detected (typically PartitionedAssetLauncherJob).

max_iterations.label: Max Iterations
max_iterations.description: Cap on revise cycles per partition. Once reached, sensor STOPS re-triggering and marks the partition exhausted.

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: If target assets are dynamic-partitioned, name of the DynamicPartitionsDefinition.

feedback_subdir.label: Feedback Subdir
feedback_subdir.description: Where feedback text files are written under approval_dir.

emit_state_asset.label: Emit State Asset
emit_state_asset.description: Emit a DataFrame asset `{sensor_name}_state` with one row per partition currently in a feedback loop.
